description: Returns the console top-up page link (url) and the current balance (balance_usd). Use it when a call fails with quota_exhausted or ai_topup_required, or when the user asks how to add funds. The account owner pays in the console; this tool creates no order and charges nothing. Any key can use it; accounts whose service provider handles top-ups get topup_unavailable. Free.
name: everyinfra_get_topup_link
title: Top-up link
